title: The Cellar Door
journal: Never-Writes-Twice says Fort Chalkmoth is a fort like any other, but a wounded Unbound scout told me to ask what moans in its cellar. This is my own errand, not the order's; the hunt waits at Bell Station and either may come first. Fort Chalkmoth is the Archwardens' fort on the Chixathe Mesa above Noota Nara. I'm to get into the fort and see its cellar: the wall captain at the gate may let me in, or I may find another way in unseen.
objectives: Get into Fort Chalkmoth's keep, by the wall captain's leave or unseen. (marker: Sakeeus-Wan, Door to Fort Chalkmoth Guardroom)

plan.going: This is my own errand, to see what moans in the cellar of Fort Chalkmoth; the order's hunt, at Bell Station, is open beside it and either may come first.
plan.next: Get into Fort Chalkmoth's keep, on the mesa above Noota Nara.
plan.ways: Ask the wall captain at the gate for leave, or go in unseen by the trapdoor in the yard.

answers: I am hunting the seven marked drowned towers for the order via the Kings Marker Stone, but I came to Fort Chalkmoth on my own errand: a wounded Unbound scout said to ask what moans in its cellar. The Unbound and the collector Vanin are also after this.
Get into the fort keep and see its cellar, at Fort Chalkmoth on Chixathe Mesa.
Ask the wall captain Sakeeus-Wan for leave to enter, or find another way in unseen, e.g. picking the locked keep door or using the guardroom door.
I do not know what moans in the cellar or who the Sarpa Raiders are here. I can find out by talking and exploring.

title: The Cellar Door
journal: The wall captain, Sakeeus-Wan, says a Toh-Wo may sleep in the barracks, but the keep stays shut to strangers while three Sarpa raiders rob the chalk carts on the western approach. I'm to kill the three raiders; then he will open the keep and pay me. I can still go in unseen by the trapdoor in the yard instead.
objectives: Kill the three Sarpa raiders on Fort Chalkmoth's western approach. (marker: Sarpa Raider, Sarpa Raider, Sarpa Raider)
Tell the wall captain the raiders are dead. (marker: Sakeeus-Wan)

plan.going: The captain will open the keep once the raiders on the western approach are dead.
plan.next: Kill the three Sarpa raiders, then tell the captain.
plan.ways: Fight the raiders (any weapon or magic), or skip the captain and go in by the trapdoor unseen.

answers: The wall captain Sakeeus-Wan will only open the keep if I kill three Sarpa raiders robbing carts on the western approach, then pays 100 gold.
Kill the raiders and report back, or go in unseen.
Fight the raiders, or use the trapdoor in the yard to get in unseen, or pick the keep door.
I do not know what is in the cellar; the old prison below is the order own, per the captain.

title: The Cellar Door
journal: I came up through the trapdoor in the yard into the cellar's guardroom, unseen. If the garrison sees me in here, they will attack. The stair from the guardroom climbs to the quartermaster's store. I'm to see what I can of the cellar: the store above, the gaoler at the stair's foot and the inner door.
objectives: Look in the quartermaster's store at the top of the cellar stair. (marker: Jar of Hist Sap (Jal-Veesa Knot))
Speak to the gaoler at the foot of the cellar stair. (marker: Tsleel-Vaku)
Try the cellar door. (marker: Door to Cellar Door)

plan.going: I am inside unseen, in the guardroom below the keep. Being seen means a fight with the garrison.
plan.next: Three things, in any order: look in the store at the top of the stair, speak to the gaoler, try the cellar door.
plan.ways: Stay unseen; persuade the gaoler or test him with Illusion for more (optional).

answers: I got into the cellar guardroom unseen through the yard trapdoor. If the garrison sees me they attack. Something moans in the cellar and I want to know what.
Look at the quartermaster store, speak to the gaoler Tsleel-Vaku, and try the locked cellar door.
Talk to the gaoler, check the store upstairs (a Jar of Hist Sap marked Jal-Veesa Knot), or pick the cellar door.
I do not know what the Jal-Veesa Knot is or why a jar of Hist Sap is marked; I could ask the gaoler or look closer.

title: The Cellar Door
journal: Jars of Hist sap marked with Jal-Veesa's knot are stacked by the cellar stair, in a fort with no Hist of its own. The order's gaoler turned me away from the inner door, Toh-Wo or not, and said Never-Writes-Twice keeps its key. Behind the door, something moans. Who is down there, and why the order feeds them sap, I cannot learn here. I'm to go back to the order's hunt for the drowned tower that Bell Station's divers know.

plan.going: The cellar holds people who moan behind a locked door, fed on sap from Jal-Veesa; Never-Writes-Twice keeps the key; why is an open question.
plan.next: Go back to the hunt at Bell Station, east of Lilmoth.

answers: Quest over: the cellar holds something that moans and sleeps and dreams, fed Hist sap marked with Jal-Veesa knot by the order, in a fort without Hist. The gaoler says Never-Writes-Twice holds the key.
Go back to the hunt: Bell Station, east of Lilmoth by boat, for the drowned tower.
Bell Station first, or return to Helstrom and press Never-Writes-Twice about the key.
I do not know who is down there or who Jal-Veesa is; I could ask Never-Writes-Twice or others.
